column1: # What the code NativeContractTable.tsv cites calls, where its row does not cite that too: each a function or macro vouched for, by reading it, as running no managed code.
# TestNativeContractTable holds every call that a routine a row cites makes, as the text spells it, to a routine the row cites or one vouched for here, matching by name.

#   callee   path:symbol under src/coreclr (a path may climb out of it, as ../native/minipal does), as the contract table cites one, with =spelling after it where a macro pastes the name together, giving the text that defines it; or -:symbol for a function of the C library or the operating system

#   runs     nothing (it runs no managed code); exception (it runs no managed code but the constructor of the exception it throws); loads (it runs no managed code when every type it loads is found without the program's assembly resolution handlers, so every row whose code calls it holds under NamedTypesLoad); or unreached (it may run anything, and the cited code calls it only on a path the native never takes)
